processingFindings.correction: Prepare the same existing programs after a black loading draw in the same SDL/GL context. Hold GuiStore phase0 and 100% until catalog publication and graphics preparation have completed, then retain the original welcome, cover-readiness and entry sequence. A catalog failure uses the original intro transition after its error frame, without claiming 100%
processingFindings.fallback: One real failed preparation attempt may complete with the original R104/R106/base-art fallback; no endless loading retry is introduced

facts: GuiStore uses the existing 30fps monotonic schedule with sleeping SDL_Delay; it does not impose 30fps on emulator execution
Loading returns through a black surface before cloud, wave, avatar, icon or decorative post-render work
Cloud field is 320x180 at 15Hz and reused on intervening menu frames
Waves use three strips with 32 segments each and no image/FBO generation
Background-off avoids both cloud and wave draw paths; graphics preferences are read through an atomic snapshot without per-frame JNI or storage IO
processingFindings.residualCost: The visible menu still renders at 30fps even for a static scene; a lower or event-driven cadence requires separate animation/input measurements and was not changed here

facts: Only the focused platform requests loop and the selected preference must allow it
One active decoder is retained; loop seeks and restarts the same MediaPlayer, Surface and decoder without reopening the asset
Collections retain the existing single-pass/end-frame hold behaviour
Preparation/openFd runs on the video worker through prepareAsync
Hidden/paused/stopped/destroyed frontend tears down active sessions; the watchdog runs only for active decoding
unprovenMeasurementCandidates: Synchronous Surface/SurfaceTexture release latency on the calling thread
One-time poster texture uploads before the first decoder

facts: Catalogue/network work remains on bounded workers; an unchanged revision/display name is not republished
Only cache misses enter sequential cover warm-up; local covers do not download again each menu entry
Cover decode/publication uses bounded queues, selected-cover priority and foreground cancellation
The observed startup had every cover local and downloaded zero covers
User-requested downloads keep their foreground-service ownership and delayed network retry/cancel behaviour
Robot/Lottie work follows visible menu draws rather than independent hidden-menu timers; frozen icons retain their current frame
Theme frame textures are bounded and decoded/uploaded only when the frame changes
Online wave callbacks are removed on detach/focus loss/disabled effects
Online LED GPU requests are coalesced and gated by attachment, visibility, focus, bitmap readiness and the effect preference
unprovenMeasurementCandidates: SharedPreferences.commit in the native theme setter can briefly block on a human theme change, not continuously
Shader creation after an online GL context loss needs its own measured timing; no new physical online timing is claimed
